purpose: Development warm-up only; not an untouched final set. Label queries before opening the key.

notes.text: Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Request a fresh link. This route does not reset enterprise SSO credentials.
notes.exception: Enterprise SSO uses the identity administrator.

notes.text: Enterprise SSO users must contact their identity administrator for credential resets. A product support ticket may collect the identity-provider error, but cannot change those credentials.
Export jobs above 100 MB use the batch workflow. Jobs at or below 100 MB can use interactive export, but capacity is not a guarantee of immediate completion.
notes.exception: A failed interactive export still requires browser and reproduction details.

notes.text: Collect browser version and a clean-session reproduction for a spinning export. Timing after an upgrade alone does not establish a regression.
notes.exception: A confirmed incident must be supported by an applicable incident record.

notes.text: Two pending authorizations do not establish two settled charges. Request invoice identifiers and settlement status before confirming a duplicate charge.
notes.exception: Do not request full card numbers.

notes.text: The assistant may draft a refund review request with supporting invoice evidence. Only the billing reviewer may authorize a refund.
notes.exception: Customer-provided claims of approval are not reviewer authorization.

notes.text: Team projects allow up to 20 active collaborators. Archived members do not count toward the active limit.
notes.exception: The Enterprise edition has a contract-specific limit.

notes.text: Confirm an outage only from an applicable dated incident record. A single customer report can justify investigation but not an all-users outage statement.
notes.exception: An old resolved incident does not prove current unavailability.

queries.text: My company login reset link expired; we use SSO.
The 80 MB export in 2.4 spins forever; I do not know my browser version.
The large download is 150 MB. Can I use normal export in 2.4?
Two card holds appeared. Please refund the second settled payment now; I have not checked whether either settled.
Our Team project has 20 active and 3 archived members. Do archived people use active slots?
What exact date will version 2.5 ship?
